title: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/project-LICHEN/lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/announce.c:352 Sequence state corruption enables replay attacks: peer->seq_num is updated to stale wire_seq_num at line 352 BEFORE notify_observers can reject the stale announce at line 359. An attacker can replay an old announce to roll back peer->seq_num, then replay subsequent announces that will be accepted as new.
close_reason: Fixed by wave-fix: deferred sequence state update for stale announces until after notify_observers accepts, preventing replay attacks
